concept: ProfitBridge AI: Validar dor de Ads vs Estoque no Reddit, Shopify App Store e Google Ads Community. Identificar estratégia de distribuição e lead magnet.

revenue_snapshot.fatal_flaw: API Latency/Sync Mismatch: If the 'Real-time Sync' isn't truly real-time (e.g., Shopify webhook delays or Google Ads API refresh rates), the user still wastes spend for 15-60 minutes, which invalidates the '100% stop' promise.
